title: Shop gifts and clearer payment access
summary: Choose an existing player for a gift, manage your payments separately, and choose whether to share shop statistics.
body:
- Buy for yourself or give a gift by choosing a player who has already joined Cookie Build. Search by Minecraft name and confirm the suggested recipient before payment.
- Java and Bedrock names are supported. For Bedrock players, searching with or without the initial dot finds the same player.
- The selected player receives the cosmetic access. The payer keeps separate access to their order and billing management; choosing a recipient does not give access to that player’s account.
- Optional shop statistics now have clear Allow and Decline choices. Change your choice at any time from Analytics preferences in the footer. Declining does not affect play, gifts or purchases.
- Existing shop prices and the free Cookie Sparkles trail remain unchanged.
